name: PMSM Motor – 120S – 60H – 1250W
description: The VoltWorks 120S-60H-1250W PMSM motor delivers high-torque, energy-efficient performance for L3 e-passenger vehicles. Rated at 48V/60V with 1250W continuous power and a peak torque of 30 Nm, it features IP66 waterproofing and forced fan air cooling, making it ideal for Indian road and weather conditions. Designed for e-rickshaw passenger applications with a supported GVW of 700 kg and top speeds of ~35 km/h.

name: PMSM Motor – 120S – 70H – 1500W
description: The VoltWorks 120S-70H-1500W PMSM motor is purpose-built for L3 e-loader applications requiring high torque and heavy-load capability. Operating at 48V/60V with 1500W continuous power and a peak torque of 37 Nm, it supports a GVW of up to 1000 kg with IP65/IP66 protection. Equipped with forced fan air cooling and overload protection, it is engineered for reliable performance in demanding cargo and loader vehicle segments.

name: PMSM Motor – 133S – 60H – 1650W
description: The VoltWorks 133S-60H-1650W PMSM motor brings the 133S frame to the mid-power three-wheeler segment, slotting between the 1500W and 2050W offerings. Operating at 48V/60V with 1650W of continuous power, it uses the same Hairpin Winding construction and forced fan air cooling as the rest of the 133S family, and pairs with the 24 MOS 60A 1650W controller for passenger and loader applications.

name: PMSM Motor – 133S – 70H – 2050W
description: The VoltWorks 133S-70H-2050W PMSM motor leverages advanced Hairpin Winding Technology to deliver peak torques exceeding 68 Nm across L5 passenger, loader, and cargo three-wheelers. Compatible with 48V, 60V, and 72V systems, it provides 2050W of continuous power with 20% gradability and IP66 protection. Its multi-voltage architecture and wide RPM range (up to 6000 RPM at 72V) make it ideal for versatile three-wheeler applications.

name: PMSM Motor – 140S – 60H – 2500W
description: The VoltWorks 140S-60H-2500W PMSM motor extends the L5 lineup with a versatile mid-power option for passenger and cargo three-wheelers. Compatible with 48V, 60V, and 72V systems, it delivers 2500W continuous power with a peak torque of 58 Nm and speeds up to 6000 RPM at 72V. With IP67 waterproofing, forced fan air cooling, and support for a GVW of 1000 kg with 20% gradability, it is built for dependable all-weather urban transport duty.

name: PMSM Motor – 140S – 75H – 3250W
description: The VoltWorks 140S-75H-3250W PMSM motor is designed for high-performance L5 passenger, loader, and cargo three-wheelers demanding sustained power and exceptional torque. With Hairpin Winding Technology and peak torques above 75 Nm, it delivers 3250W continuous output across 48V, 60V, and 72V systems. It supports a GVW of 1200 kg, achieves up to 6200 RPM, and maintains IP66 waterproofing for all-weather durability.

name: PMSM Motor – 140S – 85H – 4250W
description: The VoltWorks 140S-85H-4250W PMSM motor is the flagship high-power unit in the L5 lineup, engineered specifically for demanding loader applications. Featuring Hairpin Winding Technology, it delivers peak torque over 80 Nm with 4250W continuous power across 48V, 60V, and 72V platforms. Rated IP66 and supporting a GVW of up to 1500 kg with 20% gradability, it is built to handle the most challenging last-mile freight conditions in India.

name: PMSM Motor – 10"S – 27H – 1000W
description: The VoltWorks 10-inch 27H Motor is a compact, oil-cooled PMSM solution built for L2 electric scooters. With a peak torque of 73.3 Nm, dual Hall sensors, and a thicker 2.3 mm magnet design, it offers superior efficiency and precise motor control for urban two-wheeler applications. Compatible with 48V/60V systems, it supports both disc and drum brake configurations for flexible OEM integration.

name: PMSM Controller – 24 MOS – 60A – 1250W
description: The VoltWorks 24 MOS 60A controller is a compact FOC drive built for 1250W L3 e-rickshaw drivetrains. Operating at 48V/60V with a 60A peak DC current, 150A peak phase current, and peak efficiency above 95%, it combines precise Field-Oriented Control with Hall sensor feedback and overload protection via an integrated temperature sensor. IP54-rated and air cooled, it is the matched controller for the 120S-60H-1250W PMSM motor.

name: PMSM Controller – 30 MOS – 60A – 1500W
description: The VoltWorks 30 MOS 60A controller delivers 1500W of drive power for L3 e-rickshaw passenger and loader vehicles. Rated for 48V/60V operation with a 70A peak DC current, 180A peak phase current, and peak efficiency above 95%, it pairs precise Field-Oriented Control with Hall sensor compatibility and overload protection through an integrated temperature sensor. Housed in an IP54-rated, air-cooled enclosure, it is the matched controller for the 120S-70H-1500W PMSM motor.

name: PMSM Controller – 24 MOS – 60A – 1650W
description: The VoltWorks 24 MOS 60A controller in its 1650W rating is the matched drive unit for the 133S-60H-1650W PMSM motor. Built on the same compact Field-Oriented Control architecture as the 24 MOS family, it operates at 48V/60V with Hall sensor feedback, overload protection via an integrated temperature sensor, and peak efficiency above 95% in an IP54-rated, air-cooled enclosure.

name: PMSM Controller – 30 MOS – 60A – 2050W
description: The VoltWorks 30 MOS 60A controller in its 2050W rating is the drive unit for the 133S-70H-2050W PMSM motor in higher-payload three-wheeler applications. Built on the same Field-Oriented Control architecture as the rest of the MOS controller family, it operates at 48V/60V with Hall sensor feedback, overload protection via an integrated temperature sensor, and peak efficiency above 95% in an IP54-rated, air-cooled enclosure.

name: PMSM Controller – FOC – 2500W
description: The VoltWorks FOC 2500W controller is an IP67-rated, high-current drive solution for L5 three-wheeler drivetrains. Supporting 48V, 60V, and 72V systems with a 120A peak DC current, 100A continuous and 250A peak phase current, it combines Rotary Transformer sensor feedback with anti-slip logic and fully customizable software. Air cooled with overload protection via temperature sensor, it is the matched controller for the 140S-60H-2500W PMSM motor.

name: PMSM Controller – FOC – 3250W
description: The VoltWorks FOC 3250W controller powers high-performance L5 passenger and cargo three-wheelers with precise Field-Oriented Control. Operating across 48V, 60V, and 72V systems, it delivers a 120A peak DC current with 100A continuous and 250A peak phase current at peak efficiency above 95%. IP67-rated and air cooled, with Rotary Transformer sensor feedback, anti-slip logic, and customizable software, it is the matched controller for the 140S-75H-3250W PMSM motor.

name: PMSM Controller – FOC – 4250W
description: The VoltWorks FOC 4250W controller is the flagship drive unit for the L5 lineup, engineered for demanding loader duty cycles. Supporting 48V, 60V, and 72V platforms with a 120A peak DC current, 100A continuous and 250A peak phase current, it maintains peak efficiency above 95% with IP67 protection and air cooling. Rotary Transformer sensor feedback, anti-slip logic, and fully customizable software make it the matched controller for the 140S-85H-4250W PMSM motor.

name: PMSM Controller – L2 Series
description: The VoltWorks L2 FOC Motor Controller is a lightweight, compact drive unit purpose-built for L2 electric scooters and two-wheelers. Supporting 48V, 60V, and 72V systems with power ratings from 800W to 1500W and efficiency above 95%, it includes vector control, hill hold, cruise control, and three selectable operation modes. With over/under voltage protection, anti-slip logic, and Hall sensor compatibility, it is the go-to intelligent controller for next-generation electric scooter OEMs.
